newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market steady-up $2 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market steady-up $2 -USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers were $1.00-$2.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week's close, USDA said. Feeder heifers were steady to $1.00 higher.

Cattle receipts curtailed, record level 10-12 inches of rainfall. Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 67.75-75.20, including 32 head 621 lbs 75.20; 700- 800 lbs 64.50-68.00. Holsteins - Large 2 500-600 lbs 55.50-56.00; 5 head 832 lbs 56.75.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 59.00-64.50.
